summary: The slow-store probe left the regression account conditional on a scheduling precondition rather than on window width: the fall appears only when the election's term write takes effect after the off-thread write, and with equal latencies the later-starting heartbeat write lands last and leaves the higher term in place. That precondition is the boundary of the claim, so this turn registers it as a necessary question on the same investigation instead of manufacturing closing work: the next test would give the two writers asymmetric latencies, a fast write on the heartbeat path against a delayed or contended write on the election path, and count falls under natural timing. I am not spending an execution I could not interpret inside the remaining budget, and nothing else is added because the record is already complete. For a self-contained summary of what this run established: the captured tree is byte-identical to the released upstream copy of the same revision, so all findings are genuine rather than injected; six behaviours were witnessed with receipts, namely the public configuration index being a constant zero while the main thread holds the real index and a caller passing that zero back silently disables the documented compare-and-swap precondition, an accepted Apply or Barrier duty having no completion path once the node is shut down, an explicit leadership transfer to a server that holds no vote being reported as success while moving authority nowhere and costing an extra term, the AddVoter documentation promising a staging phase the implementation never enters, the transport heartbeat fast path running appendEntries off the main thread with an empty heartbeat able to flip term and leader state, and that same path never answering an accepted heartbeat once the node is down, where the release depends on the transport. The regression was reproduced on a fresh schedule and causally controlled, the no-response case was traced to the transport-supplied release, a log-cache divergence suspicion was refuted within a stated scope, and two uninstrumented probes bounded the regression's natural rate at zero falls in 792 and 768 deliveries while explaining why the ordering is not reached under equal treatment of the two writers.
